productName: Focus Wall — Bounded 10-Sticky-Note Visual Board in Your Browser Side Panel

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of keeping active visual sticky notes visible while browsing getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With Focus Wall, Intentional 10-Note Cap Prevents Sprawl runs right where you already work. Drag-and-Drop Reordering & Warm Color Coding and Persistent Side-Panel Visibility Across Tabs—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle keeping active visual sticky notes visible while browsing, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch Focus Wall in action: Hard-bounded to 10 active sticky notes so your board stays a sharp working-memory aid instead of a chaotic wall of 200 forgotten cards. Group and prioritize your thoughts visually with tactile drag-and-drop cards and calm, high-contrast color palettes. Plus, unlike new-tab sticky note extensions that vanish when you open a site, Focus Wall stays docked right beside your active research or email. Copy any sticky note or export your entire board to a clean local text file anytime—with zero accounts and zero subscriptions. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
